By hand or by courier services will not be accepted. If Physical EMD FDR or DD not received on or before last date of physical submission date the bid will not be accepted. Except these 2 d ocuments, all other documents are to be uploaded online in Gem duly self attested with sta mp. 8. The successful bidder shall deposit additionally a security deposit equivalent to 5% of the te nder value within 5 days from the date of award of contract. 9. The items not according to requirements will be returned to the bidder and the bidder will have to replace that item within the given time limit. 10. Any Bidder failing to submit any of the above documents with the technical bid, such bid wil l not be accepted. 12. The submission of the tender will mean that the terms and conditions set by the Nagar Niga m Birgaon, Chhattisgarh acceptable to the bidder/ supplier. 17. In the event of any dispute, the decision of the Commissioner, Nagar Nigam Birgaon, Chhattis garh shall be the final verdict.
